description:
Find functions by name or concept across the whole codebase.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• You're about to write a function, helper or utility: check it doesn't already exist
• You need to know where something is implemented (e.g. "retry", "validate", "notify")

RETURNS: Matching functions with file path, line range, module, signature, export status and complexity.

USE INSTEAD OF: grep or glob to find a function. Text matches miss re-exports, aliases and barrel files, and include every comment and string naming it.

file.description: Only this file (full path matches exactly, a file name as a substring)

query.description: Function name or part of one

repo.description: Repository name — one of your connected repos.

name: search_functions
